provides consumer financial products including checking/savings accounts, credit and debit cards, and home, auto, personal and small business lending to individuals and businesses primarily in the US
delivers wealth management, brokerage, financial planning, private banking, trust and fiduciary services to high-net-worth and institutional clients
provides commercial banking, credit and capital markets solutions to private, family-owned and public companies across multiple industry sectors and municipalities

name_reality_gap: none — Wells Fargo is understood as a large bank and the Financial Services label is accurate; though the technology function (~18% of staffing) is underrepresented in the Financial Services framing.
